summary: Lewis Hamilton faces redemption at the Circuit of the Americas as Kimi Antonelli hunts the championship he can clinch this weekend, with the Ferrari driver's dominant form threatening to end Mercedes' reign atop the standings. George Russell's late-season resurgence puts McLaren's constructors' battle in jeopardy while Hamilton's strategy miscue in Singapore demands he extract maximum points to salvage his team's hopes. A title coronation for Antonelli would mark Ferrari's first drivers' championship in two decades and reshape the constructor's championship narrative heading into the final rounds.
